newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Japanese venture fund buys into RFM unit.
newsitem.headline: Japanese venture fund buys into RFM unit.

text.p: Food and beverage conglomerate RFM Corp said on Monday Nomura/Jafco Investment (Asia) Ltd, a venture capital fund of Japan, had acquired a minority stake in its subsidiary PSi Tehnologies Inc.
RFM chief executive officer Jose Concepcion III said in a statement that the investment provided the much needed capital for PSi to expand its operations.
He did not say how much money was generated from the sale.
PSi is a manufacturer of power devices which help drive motors used in computer disk drives and regulate power for cellular phones and beepers.
Its clients include technology giants such as Motorola, Samsung, and Texas Instruments.
Concepcion also said it planned to sell part of its microelectronic subsidiary to the public within three years' time.
"PSi is RFM's participation in the rapidly growing and highly profitable semiconductor industry," he said.
